drafts.subject: Hold: possible impersonation of Otway Adhesives (V1005) - invoice OA-02325, PO 4500012103
drafts.body:
Hi team,

We've received invoice OA-02325 for $6,336.00 against PO 4500012103 (buyer M. Tran) from Otway Adhesives Pty Ltd. The name matches vendor V1005, but the ABN on the invoice (48 427 975 421) isn't in the vendor master and differs from the ABN on file (10 398 434 205). The invoice also says the vendor's bank details have changed.

This could be a restructure or an impersonation attempt. Please:
1. Do not change any bank details or vendor records based on this invoice or its attached letter.
2. Verify the invoice, the ABN and the claimed change by phone, using the contact details already on file for V1005 and not those printed on the invoice.
3. Let AP know the outcome so we can decide whether to release or reject the invoice.

The invoice is on hold and must not be paid until you confirm.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
